title: ScienceQA Multimodal Reasoning
description: Multimodal science question answering with chain-of-thought reasoning, based on ScienceQA (Lu et al., NeurIPS 2022). Annotators answer multiple-choice science questions that may include images, provide chain-of-thought explanations, and categorize the science domain.
overview: ScienceQA is a multimodal science question answering benchmark from Lu and colleagues at NeurIPS 2022. Its distinguishing feature is that most questions come with a grounding lecture and a written explanation, supporting chain-of-thought reasoning rather than answer-only prediction.

The questions are multiple-choice items drawn from elementary and high-school science curricula. Many pair a question with an image such as a diagram, map, or photo, so answering can require reading both text and a visual.

The dataset has 21,208 questions spanning 3 subjects, 26 topics, and 127 categories; 48.7% include an image, 83.9% include a lecture, and 90.5% include an explanation. Annotating the reasoning, not just the answer, is what makes it useful for studying explanations.

The Potato config below reproduces the task with a radio for the answer choice, a text field for the explanation, and a multiselect for the reasoning skills involved. Use it to extend ScienceQA or to collect explained answers for your own questions.
